rules.development_gate: >=30 trades, PF>=1.15, positive return; both chronological calendar entry-time halves positive with PF>1; missing histories remain disclosed, no coverage gate waived
rules.coverage_gate: Any unpriced held M5 interval, incomplete signal-indicator lookback or incomplete management constituent blocks eligible evidence. rules.validation_gate: >=30 trades, PF>=1.15, positive return, development gate and majority positive joint neighbors
